scraped.scraped_description: AI Wargamer and Global Risk Simulator. Contribute to SentinelTeam/grim development by creating an account on GitHub.

name: GRIM (Global Risk Simulator)
tagline: AI Wargamer and Global Risk Simulator — a Telegram bot for simulating and role-playing global catastrophic risk scenarios
sdg_alignment: SDG 16: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions

news_articles.headline: Scaling Wargaming for Global Catastrophic Risks with AI
news_articles.outlet: Sentinel Team Blog / LessWrong / EA Forum

academic_citations.title: Safe storage and effective monitoring of CO <sub>2</sub> in depleted gas fields
The magnitude and causes of uncertainty in global model simulations of cloud condensation nuclei

outcome_methodology: Not applicable — research/simulation tool without direct policy implementation
documented_limitations: Realism limited by quality of LLM game-master outputs
Expert agents not yet built in
failure_modes: LLM hallucination producing unrealistic scenario outcomes
Low adoption limits value of collective intelligence
curation_criteria: Open-source contribution model; pull requests reviewed by maintainers; focus on scenario quality and AI agent behavior
contributor_governance: Open pull requests and issues; maintainers offer onboarding for consistent contributors
disparity_tracking: Not tracked — research tool without demographic user data collection
community_ownership: Limited — maintained by Sentinel Team core team; community contributions welcome but governance remains centralized
ai_involvement: Core functionality: uses Claude Sonnet 3.7 and OpenAI models as Forecaster agents and Game Master; fully AI-driven scenario simulation
